title: Size of the binary multiplication table
statement: Let $\ell>0$ and choose a monic irreducible polynomial of degree $\ell$ over $\mathbb F_2$, represented by its $\ell$ lower coefficients. The list of triples $(a,b,ab)$ for all ordered pairs of binary vectors of length $\ell$, with multiplication performed modulo this polynomial by the specified implementation, has length $2^{2\ell}$.
hypotheses_covered: The implementation's monic modulus polynomial is irreducible
